title: Kazhdan–Lusztig \(R\)-polynomial 的 \(q\)-Fibonacci product formula：首个未验证 \(n=10\)
summary: The complete n=10 endpoint is certified: all 6,229,297 comparable pairs in the 12,866-element interval satisfy the q-Fibonacci product formula. This does not prove the all-n conjecture.
evidence: The no-import verifier reconstructed 12,866 elements and 6,229,297 comparable pairs at n=10 with zero nonmembers.
Normalized tilde-R and ordinary R recurrences agreed exactly for every pair.
The n=2,...,9 baseline was independently reproduced.
Eight malformed/tampered certificate variants were rejected fail-closed, including an overflowing endpoint.
The breaker route reproduced the result twice and under ASan/UBSan without importing verifier output.
A latest-hash independent referee rerun, UBSan check, citation audit, clean LaTeX build, and seven-page PDF inspection all passed.
For every n=2,...,10, the observed normalized classes equal exactly the product classes indexed by nondecreasing h_i>=2 with sum h_i<=n-2.
author: Zijian Zeng
